summary: Important: rust-sequoia-sq security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
Command-line frontends for Sequoia.

Security Fix(es):

* sequoia-openpgp: sequoia-openpgp: Cryptographic integrity compromise via key flag confusion (CVE-2026-42784)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Unbundle capnproto from sequoia-sq [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-177547)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
